substantive_checks.product_divisor: PASS: primewise truncated valuation gives gcd(Q,A) dividing the weighted product of the primitive overlaps and gcd(Q,D)=gcd(Q,A)
substantive_checks.efficiency_bound: PASS: division by log A turns the overlap majorant into a weighted average, so no unbounded product beats its best primitive return per unit height
substantive_checks.height_dichotomy: PASS: H=O(n) forces K<=L=O(n/log n), while positive-linear capture forces one O(n/log n) gap with fixed positive primitive overlap efficiency
substantive_checks.power_layers: PASS: successive captured layers from repeated powers form a divisibility-decreasing chain and create no prime support
substantive_checks.canonical_optimizer: PASS: with unrestricted multiplicity the exact anti-period gap cost for certified depth s is s(p-1), attained by repeated depth-one factors
substantive_checks.canonical_capacity: PASS: the anti-period yield-to-height ratio is O(1/log n) uniformly over odd primes and multi-prime assignments, hence total certified capacity is o(n)
substantive_checks.sum_split: PASS: homogeneous scalar sums reduce to residual continuant sums modulo Q; a unique least p-valuation gives no extra depth, while tied minima define the genuinely open cancellation quotient
substantive_checks.reservoir_deoverlap: PASS: Q is arbitrary inside q_n/gcd(q_n,D_m), so every product and sum statement is already normalized against Item 265
substantive_checks.capacity_booking: PASS: no actual-family high-efficiency return cover or prime-independent target-cancelling sum is proved; retained beta capacity and booking are unchanged

strict_scope.proved: All finite unbounded-multiplicity product portfolios are dominated in captured divisor per unit height by one primitive return; canonical anti-period portfolios have zero linear capacity.
strict_scope.not_proved: Actual high-efficiency short returns, a weighted return cover, tied-minimum cancellation in prime-independent sums, nonhomogeneous sums, and arbitrary growing blocks remain open.
strict_scope.finite_only: The deterministic replay checks exact identities and cancellation witnesses but makes no density or exceptional-prime extrapolation.
